description.narrative: The project aims to enhance the capacity of member countries in effective trade policy. This includes research and knowledge products, training and workshops, and global advocacy and consensus-building on intra-Commonwealth, regional and global trade and investment; trade, SDGs and economic resilience; multilateral trade; and trade support for Least Developed Countries. The project will also address new and emerging trade issues, including digital trade, climate change and environment, global and regional supply chains and related development issues.
